description: The plot titled “ReDial” illustrates how two ranking metrics (Recall@50 and NDCG@50) vary with search depth, while also showing constant reference levels for a baseline method (ReFICR). The x-axis is an unlabeled numeric axis representing search depth, shown on a linear scale from 1 to 5 with integer tick marks at 1-unit intervals. The left y-axis is labeled “Recall@50,” displayed on a linear scale from 0.30 to 0.60 with ticks spaced by 0.05. The right y-axis is labeled “NDCG@50,” displayed on a linear scale from 0.15 to 0.22 with ticks spaced by 0.01. Four lines are shown: a green solid line with circular markers for “Recall@50 (Ours),” which rises from about 0.35 at depth 1 to about 0.43 at depth 2, about 0.47 at depth 3, about 0.48 at depth 4, and about 0.49 at depth 5; a green dotted horizontal line for “Recall@50 (ReFICR)” that stays constant at roughly 0.47 across all depths; a blue solid line with square markers for “NDCG@50 (Ours),” which increases from about 0.16 at depth 1 to about 0.18 at depth 2, about 0.18–0.19 at depth 3, about 0.19 at depth 4, and remains around 0.19 at depth 5; and a blue dotted horizontal line for “NDCG@50 (ReFICR)” that stays constant near 0.155 across all depths.
